title: The Blackpool Combat Club & the war with Jericho
summary: Moxley and Danielson’s alliance forms around William Regal, then becomes entangled in Eddie Kingston’s war with the Jericho Appreciation Society.

chapters.title: Regal brings rivals together
chapters.result: Regal makes Moxley and Danielson shake hands after their match.
chapters.context: The reconciliation lays the foundation for the Blackpool Combat Club.

chapters.title: Anarchy in the Arena
chapters.result: The Jericho Appreciation Society defeat the opposing alliance.
chapters.context: The faction conflict spills throughout the arena.

chapters.title: The alliance wins Blood & Guts
chapters.result: The BCC-led team defeat the Jericho Appreciation Society.
chapters.context: Claudio’s submission victory also frustrates Kingston’s personal pursuit of Jericho.
